title: Reverse a linked list
summary: Walk down a train unhooking each carriage and re-hooking it to face backwards, holding just three carriages at a time.

examples.label: Five carriages
examples.explanation: Every coupling now points the other way.

ladder.name: Copy the numbers and rebuild
ladder.idea: Copy every carriage number into an array, then build a new train from the end.

ladder.name: Turn the rest, then this one
ladder.idea: Recursively reverse the train after the first carriage, then hook the first carriage on at the end.
ladder.insight: No copy is needed: the existing couplings can be turned around. Recursion does it but keeps one call per carriage on the call stack.

ladder.name: Three hands: before, current, next
ladder.idea: Walk from the front. Save the next carriage, point the current one back at the previous, then step forward.
ladder.insight: Turning one coupling only needs the carriage before and the carriage after, so three pointers replace the recursion's whole call stack.

transfer.problem: Reverse only carriages 2 to 4 of a train, leaving the others in place.
transfer.explanation: Walk to the carriage before position 2, reverse the stretch with the same three pointers, then reconnect both ends.

selfCheck: Returns prev, the old last carriage.
Handles an empty train and a one-carriage train.
